items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: I worked at the Dream Land with him about three years before I got good.

ctx.x: Kepler had a good size band? Yeah. I worked at the Dream Land with him about three years before I got good. Well, I mean, when I first hit Chicago, he picked me up, see. Picked me up. He was right there.
